launcher.type_prompt_subtitle: Send a one-off task to Hermes
launcher.new_session_description: Create a new Hermes RPC session
launcher.resume_latest_description: Resume the stored session when available

bridge_host.label: Bridge host
bridge_host.description: Host of the bridge; in client-only mode this is the forwarded address

bridge_port.label: Bridge port
bridge_port.description: Port of the bridge; it must match the local port of the SSH tunnel

state_file.label: State file
state_file.description: Where the bridge writes its state; the auth token is read from the same directory

hermes_home.label: Hermes home
hermes_home.description: Directory holding the Hermes configuration; auto-detected when left at the default

hermes_command.label: Hermes command
hermes_command.description: Hermes executable the bridge runs for gateway and one-shot commands

auto_start_bridge.label: Auto-start bridge
auto_start_bridge.description: Start the local bridge when Noctalia loads

auto_start_gateway.label: Auto-start gateway
auto_start_gateway.description: Start the Hermes gateway when it is not running

client_only_mode.label: Client-only mode (remote bridge)
client_only_mode.description: Connect to a Hermes bridge running on a remote server over SSH instead of starting one locally. Set host and port to the forwarded address and paste the bridge token below.

bridge_token.label: Bridge token
bridge_token.description: Token printed by the server helper (hermes-bridge-serve.sh). Required in client-only mode.

status_poll_interval.label: Status poll interval
status_poll_interval.description: Seconds between bridge health checks and idle state polls

hide_when_idle.label: Hide when idle
hide_when_idle.description: Only show the bar pill when Hermes is active or needs attention

show_tool_activity.label: Show tool activity
show_tool_activity.description: Keep tool calls collapsed into a compact activity line

default_provider.label: Default provider
default_provider.description: Fallback provider shown when the session reports none

default_model.label: Default model
default_model.description: Fallback model shown when the session reports none
